title: Aster at the suspended arena
description: Original stylized martial-arts action composition: a teal-and-tangerine courier in a planted/bent-knee stance, open casting palm and raised fist, swept asymmetric short hair, boots, wraps and wind-swept scarf. Faceted floating islands, fragments, a broken masonry arc, ambient-only painted blue backdrop/opaque cloud staging and cyan/gold energy accents. No licensed character references. Emission is visible only; explicit point/directional lights, not GI, illuminate the scene.
